about_the_game:
Wish Creatures is a Turn-Based Monster Taming game where monsters leave your party when they "Level Up".

As you battle, Monsters regain the Courage they lost when they fell to Earth. When a Monster fully regains its lost Courage, it will automatically leave your team to re-enter the Cosmos as a Star. You can wish on a Star to use their signature battle action, known as a "Star Power"! Balance your ever-changing team with Star Power to take down the most powerful foes!

Demo Contents:

  • Two difficulties: Chill (Start battles with enough Stardust for any Wish) and Locked In (Start battles with no Stardust)

  • Talk, battle, and part ways with 7 monster species (more appear as opponents)

  • The first explorable areas of the full game: the Woods and Mt. Upright

  • Battle your way through Monster Controllers and fight a powerful boss monster at the end!

  • Upgrade battle actions with Debris you buy in the general store!

  • Use the Cosmos menu to hunt for rare monster forms called "Pulsars"

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel(R) Celeron(R) CPU N3150 @ 1.60GHz 1.60 GHz
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel(R) HD Graphics ver 20.19.15.4835
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Intel(R) Diplay Audio
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: If in doubt, use the most recent stable DirectX driver.

short_description: Monsters are fallen stars. Raise their Courage through turn-based battle and send them home! Recruit Monsters through conversation, fill the Cosmos, and Wish on the Stars you make in future battles! And when it matters most... what do you Wish for?
